alerts.title: Palk Strait Shallow Sandbar Warning
alerts.areaDescription: Shallow shifting sandbars near Kodiyakkarai Point with depth < 2.5m CD.
alerts.advisoryAction: Small craft advised to maintain minimum 1.5 km clearance from shoal crest.

alerts.title: Afternoon Convective Squall Warning
alerts.areaDescription: Convective thunderstorm cells moving SW across outer shelf post-13:30 IST.
alerts.advisoryAction: Vessels must complete operations and return to harbor before 13:00 IST.
